revise.summary: I revised content/lessons/17-retro.md against the 1.3.1 retro and writing-for-agents SKILL.md files, the Claude Code memory, commands and sessions docs, and the local transcripts of BsJGo1wFTvQ, 9tmsq-Gvx6g and -QFHIoCo-Ko. The accuracy fixes: AGENTS.md is now described as read only when there's no CLAUDE.md, auto memory is acknowledged, every use of Matt's reviewer names /mattpocock-skills:code-review, /retro is described as proposing fixes (not making them), the PR-talk claim no longer gives retro a pull-request-reading power, and the findings table and the close paraphrases are rewritten in the author's own words. Matt's Scene now matches the transcript: a batch of sessions, no category-like labels, 'ran a release without asking'. The Try it now works from zero: Node.js prerequisite with a check, what to do when /retro is listed, a plan-mode check, how to spot the writing-for-agents load, and a checklist that a correct run can't fail. The Final test grew to 10 with scenario-earns-a-line (goal 3), fresh cases replace the body's own examples in repeat-mistake and spot-negation, and the right answers are no longer reliably the shortest. Goal 4 was narrowed to what the Final test checks. The 2,911 words are trimmed to fit, with a repo-only Site story.
